law.attributes: Eir Labs Inc, a Delaware corporation, as Provider under the Lighthouse Pilot Statement of Work with Sam Ballmer (Client), signed 2026-07-24 by Eugene Stuckless, Chairman. The fee is stated payable upon execution; the governed wiki records the $25,000 payment received 2026-07-28 against invoice EIR-2026-008 (wiki-grade evidence; no located primary bank record in this corpus), so this law asserts the DELIVERY obligation, which remains open through the term.
law.aim: Deliver the contracted Lighthouse Pilot scope for the $25,000 total fixed fee, through 2026-09-30.
law.conditions: From the effective date of 2026-07-20 through 2026-09-30, for the Workstream 1 and Workstream 2 deliverables (D1.1–D1.7, D2.1–D2.4) stated in the SOW.
law.or_else: Non-delivery is an actionable breach of the statement of work, settled by binding arbitration before a single AAA arbitrator, seated in Seattle, Washington, under the laws of the United States and the State of Delaware (SOW §8, Governing Law & Arbitration).
